slot.brief: Single-blank sentence on a familiar context (e.g. weather or daily life) where one moderate word fits best among four choices.

stem:
Choose the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Although the instructions looked lengthy, their numbered steps made the process surprisingly ________ for new users.

verdicts.working: Numbered steps made the process easy to follow, so “straightforward” fits best.

working:
Numbered steps make a process easy to understand and follow; “straightforward” expresses this. “Erratic” means irregular, “obscure” means unclear, and “cumbersome” means awkward or difficult.

Independent check: Numbered steps made the process easy to follow, so “straightforward” fits best.
